units.source_text: 且说那明石浦，离须磨浦极近，几乎爬也爬得过去。

en.t: Now Akashi Bay was very close to Suma Bay, so close that one could almost crawl there.

units.source_text: 良清住在须磨，想起了明石道人的女儿，便写信去求爱。

en.t: Yoshikiyo, living at Suma, thought of the Akashi monk's daughter and wrote her a letter declaring his love.

units.source_text: 女儿没有回信，父亲却写一封信来，说“有事奉商，请劳驾来舍一行”。

en.t: The daughter did not reply, but her father sent a letter saying, "There is something I would like to discuss with you; please be so kind as to come to my house."

units.source_text: 良清想道：“女的不答应我，而要我上门去，结果教我空手回来，讨个没趣。”

en.t: Yoshikiyo thought, "The girl will not accept me, yet they want me to come to their house, only to send me back empty-handed and make a fool of me."
Feeling annoyed, he ignored the matter.
